summary: First backend testing iteration for Truck Archive MVP. Wrote 20 pytest tests covering auth (admin/operator JWT + cookie), queue seed/lookup/create, truck CRUD with retention/completeness logic, photo upload/download/delete with role-based access, dashboard summary, and user management. 20/20 tests passing after 1 minor fix.

minor.issue: Returned 500 (ObjectId not JSON serializable) - motor's insert_one mutates the dict to add _id. Fixed by popping _id before return.

action_items: Consider similar defensive doc.pop('_id') on POST /api/queue (currently works because dict order but only by luck-motor adds _id after insert; already handled).
storage.init_storage() on startup can silently fail if EMERGENT storage endpoint down; consider health-check endpoint reporting storage status.
Login endpoint lowercases username lookup but seed uses env value as-is; if ADMIN_EMAIL contained uppercase, login would break. Consider normalizing on insert too.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 500 lines - acceptable for MVP but could be split into routers/ per resource as it grows.

delete_truck marks photos with is_deleted=True but leaves them in db.photos - inconsistent with delete_photo which hard-deletes; storage objects are also orphaned (documented in comment). Consider cascade cleanup.
retention_date uses 365*2 days instead of proper 2-year timedelta (relativedelta); off-by-a-day on leap years - acceptable for MVP.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; production should set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly.
No brute force lockout on /api/auth/login - playbook recommends 5-attempt lockout (not requested for MVP but flagging).
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 3 queue items on startup (B1234ABC, D5678XYZ, L9012DEF) - verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully passing (20/20). All endpoints in review request verified. Photo upload uses Emergent object storage; tiny JPEG payload works. Frontend not tested (skipped per request). If frontend testing needed later, backend is stable base.
rca of the issue: POST /api/users 500 error: motor's AsyncIOMotorCollection.insert_one() mutates the passed dict, injecting an ObjectId under '_id'. FastAPI's default JSON encoder cannot serialize ObjectId. Fix: pop '_id' before returning. Applied same-pattern to other POST endpoints - only create_user was missing it (create_truck and create_queue already had doc.pop('_id', None)).
